basic_info.description: Welcome to this gracious, beautifully updated TOP full-floor 3 bedroom residence located on a charming block in Corona Heights on the border of Castro/Eureka Valley! Oozing w/ old-world charm & filled w/ modern luxuries, this fast-track condo-eligible full-floor unit is not to be missed. Behind a classic facade in a 2-unit building, this TIC residence is bright & spacious, featuring high ceilings, large windows that combine to create an alluring ambiance. The newly remodeled kitchen w/ center breakfast island is a chef's dream, featuring sleek cabinetry, gleaming countertops & all-new SS appliances. It seamlessly flows into an adjacent comfortable living/dining area. Modern elegance continues in the newly updated bathroom, complete w/ stunning tile & stylish details. Gorgeous refinished Douglas fir floors throughout add sophistication. The home also features all-new windows & new heating system. Additional highlights include a spacious in-unit laundry room, a beautifully landscaped shared yard, & ample private basement storage. With the best of the Castro & Market Street just a short stroll away, this location offers EZ access to vibrant shops, eateries, public transit, & freeways making it ideal for the modern urban lifestyle!
